name: Jiangsu Hualan New Pharmaceutical Material Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Hualan New Pharmaceutical Material Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of packaging materials for the injectable pharmaceuticals in China and internationally. It offers laminated and conventional rubber stoppers; halogenated butyl polytetrafluoroethylene film rubber stoppers and halogenated butyl polyester film rubber stoppers; and rubber components for pen syringes (cassette vials), assemblies for plastic infusion containers, silicone rubber products, medical devices and accessories, etc. Jiangsu Hualan New Pharmaceutical Material Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1992 and is based in Jiangyin, China.
